input: Find founder-owned US specialty chemical distributors with 50-250 employees and no private equity owner

companies.name: Lintech International LLC
companies.employees: 80 employees (current official company page, accessed 2026-11-03); company brochure separately says over 70 employees (undated). Sources: https://lintech.us/about-us/why-lintech/ and https://www.pcimag.com/ext/resources/VirtualBrochure/Lintech.pdf

criteria_evidence.evidence: Lintech describes itself as a family-owned specialty chemical distributor serving North America, with products for coatings, adhesives, plastics, road-marking, rubber and related markets.
The company says it was established in Macon, Georgia in 1983 and operates nationally, with warehouses and sales coverage across the United States.
The current official company page reports 80 employees; the corporate brochure reports over 70 employees. Both are within the requested band, although the pages do not expose publication dates.

Lintech describes itself as family-owned, privately owned and financially independent. An exact-entity review of company pages and available company/news/portfolio results found no PE owner; this is a diligence screen rather than a formal ownership registry.

companies.headcount_growth: >70 employees (company brochure, accessed 2026-11-03) to 80 employees (current official page, accessed 2026-11-03). Source pages do not state publication dates, so a dated growth rate cannot be calculated. Sources: https://www.pcimag.com/ext/resources/VirtualBrochure/Lintech.pdf and https://lintech.us/about-us/why-lintech/
companies.traction: The company brochure reports more than 30 field/inside sales representatives, 11 public warehouses plus its own warehouse locations, and coverage of coatings, inks, adhesives, polymers, rubber, plastics and composites. Source: https://www.pcimag.com/ext/resources/VirtualBrochure/Lintech.pdf
companies.rank_reason: Best documented fit: explicit family ownership and private independence, clear specialty-chemical distribution focus, a current 80-employee count in range, and a national operating footprint.

companies.name: Astro Chemicals, Inc.
companies.employees: 160 employees in the ICIS Top 100 table for 2020; current LinkedIn company size is 51–200 employees (accessed 2026-11-03). Sources: https://cjp-rbi-icis.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2021/05/07201854/Top_100_Chemical_Distributors.pdf and https://www.linkedin.com/company/astro-chemicals-inc

criteria_evidence.evidence: Astro says it is a chemical distributor serving water treatment, pharmaceuticals, coatings and adhesives, laboratories, cleaning compounds and other specialty markets.
The company is identified as based in Springfield, Massachusetts, with a 200,000-square-foot warehouse and Springfield address shown on its member profile.
The ICIS Top 100 chemical-distributor table lists 160 employees for Astro in 2020; LinkedIn currently places the company in the 51–200 employee band.

Astro describes itself as a third-generation family business. An exact-entity review of company and available company/news/portfolio results found no PE owner; this is a diligence screen rather than a formal ownership registry.

companies.headcount_growth: 160 employees in 2020 (ICIS) versus a current LinkedIn range of 51–200 employees (accessed 2026-11-03). Because the current source is a range rather than an exact count, direction and percentage growth cannot be calculated. Sources: https://cjp-rbi-icis.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2021/05/07201854/Top_100_Chemical_Distributors.pdf and https://www.linkedin.com/company/astro-chemicals-inc
companies.traction: Astro reports a 200,000-square-foot warehouse, stock of more than 1,000 molecules, company trucks/next-day delivery, and service across water treatment, pharmaceutical, coatings/adhesives, laboratory and cleaning-compound markets. Source: https://www.chemicalsdistribution.org/members/
companies.rank_reason: Strong fit on family ownership, specialty-distribution focus and employee band, with a substantial 2020 industry headcount and current 51–200 range; ranked below Lintech because the current count is not exact and the dated count is older.

companies.name: SolvChem, Inc.
companies.employees: 53 exact employees in the DataLegion observation last seen 2026-09; LinkedIn company size is 51–200 employees (accessed 2026-11-03). Sources: https://www.linkedin.com/company/solvchem and DataLegion enrichment file /workspace/exchange/exchange/datalegion_company_growth.json

criteria_evidence.evidence: SolvChem describes itself as an independent distributor of organic and inorganic chemicals, with US distribution, consumer products, contract packaging and international-distribution divisions.
The company says Gabriel Baizan founded SolvChem in 1971; its headquarters is identified as Pearland, Texas.
The exact DataLegion observation reports 53 employees last seen 2026-09; LinkedIn places the company in the 51–200 band.

Business Journal material describes SolvChem as a second-generation family-owned business, while the company calls itself independent. The reviewed exact-entity materials disclosed bank debt financing, not PE ownership; no PE owner was identified in company/news/portfolio results.

companies.headcount_growth: 50 employees in the DataLegion monthly observation for 2020-08 to 57 in 2025-08; provider current matched count is 53, last seen 2026-09. Source: DataLegion enrichment file /workspace/exchange/exchange/datalegion_company_growth.json; LinkedIn band source: https://www.linkedin.com/company/solvchem
companies.last_round: Expanded senior debt financing from Amegy Bank; amount and announcement date were not stated on the opened page. The page says proceeds would refinance existing debt and fund capital investments. Source: https://www.bizjournals.com/austin/press-release/detail/9993/Westlake-Securities
companies.traction: SolvChem is described as the largest independent chemical distributor in Texas and operates chemical distribution, consumer-products, custom-blending and packaging activities serving Texas, Louisiana, Arkansas and international markets. Source: https://www.bizjournals.com/austin/press-release/detail/9993/Westlake-Securities
companies.rank_reason: Very good fit with the strongest dated headcount evidence and explicit second-generation family ownership; ranked below the more focused specialty-distributor profiles because it also operates consumer-products and contract-packaging divisions.

companies.name: The Whitaker Company
companies.employees: 60 exact employees in the DataLegion observation last seen 2026-09; LinkedIn company size is 51–200 employees (accessed 2026-11-03). Sources: https://www.linkedin.com/company/the-whitaker-company and DataLegion enrichment file /workspace/exchange/exchange/datalegion_company_growth.json

criteria_evidence.criterion: US specialty chemical and composite-material distributor
criteria_evidence.evidence: Whitaker describes itself as a chemical and composite-material distributor, blender and packager serving regional and national customers.
The company is based in Atlanta and lists facilities in Georgia, Florida and South Carolina.

The exact DataLegion observation reports 60 employees last seen 2026-09; LinkedIn places the company in the 51–200 band. Earlier provider observations were 45 in 2020-08 and 62 in 2025-08, so the current count is the qualifying one.

The Chemical Distribution Network describes Whitaker as a fourth-generation family-owned distributor. An exact-entity review of company/news/portfolio results found no PE owner; this is a diligence screen rather than a formal ownership registry.

companies.headcount_growth: 45 employees in the DataLegion monthly observation for 2020-08 to 62 in 2025-08; provider current matched count is 60, last seen 2026-09. Source: DataLegion enrichment file /workspace/exchange/exchange/datalegion_company_growth.json; LinkedIn band source: https://www.linkedin.com/company/the-whitaker-company
companies.traction: Whitaker reports three Southeast locations, chemical/composite distribution, custom blending and private-label packaging; the industry member profile says it serves thousands of customers. Source: https://www.chemicalsdistribution.org/members/
companies.rank_reason: Qualifies on current headcount, fourth-generation family ownership and specialty distribution/value-added services; ranked fourth because its historical 2020 count was below 50 and it spans both chemicals and composites.

output.search_notes: As of 2026-11-03, four exact-entity candidates were verified to the requested standard. The screen prioritized company sites, Chemical Distribution Network member material, an ICIS industry table, LinkedIn company-size pages, local business press and exact-entity PE/news searches. Excluded: Nexeo (PE-backed and much larger), ChemPoint (owned by Univar, itself acquired by Apollo), EMCO/Pride (PE-backed after Lindsay Goldberg's EMCO transaction), Harcros (over 250 employees), Shrieve (PE-backed), and employee-owned or insufficiently documented distributors such as Palmer Holland, Sea-Land, The Chemical Company, ChemGroup and Lowe. Lintech and Astro have in-range public employee evidence but not two dated exact counts; their headcount-growth strings state the limitation. SolvChem and Whitaker have dated headcount observations from the DataLegion enrichment file, whose provider citation is [1](#cite-1). No verified equity round was found for Lintech, Astro or Whitaker; SolvChem's disclosed financing was senior bank debt, not an equity round. No formal public ownership registry was available, so no PE owner means none identified after checking exact-company materials and relevant news/portfolio results, not a legal certificate. Provider-derived counts are retained at /workspace/exchange/exchange/datalegion_company_growth.json.
